scope.summary: Baseline-grid alignment MUST snap a paragraph's lines (all lines, or first line only) to a document-scoped or container-scoped baseline grid (the grid is a shared layout construct owned by 14.6, referenced here). Span/split columns MUST let a paragraph span all or N columns of its area container, or split into sub-columns, with before/after spacing and inside/outside gutter (InDesign Span/Split Columns).
acceptance_criteria: baseline-grid snap (all/first) to doc/container grid; span-all/N + split with spacing/gutter
expected_tests: live: lines snap to document/container baseline grid (all lines or first only)
test: paragraph spans all/N columns or splits with before/after spacing + gutter

target_entries: Studio / Typography / Baseline grid & column spanning

risk_if_missed: No baseline rhythm / column spanning; page-layout typography parity gap.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
